reason: Paying stage by stage after I sign off is better than what burned me last time, but the two things that matter most are blank: how the crews are checked and what happens if one stops mid-job. The service is also not open in Tbilisi yet, so I could not use it this month anyway.
objection: If a crew runs over budget or walks off halfway, who covers the loss? The stage payments limit what I hand over, but nothing written says I get my money or the job finished.
would_change_my_mind: A written rule for a crew that stops mid-job, with the money held back until it is finished, and the crew checks spelled out before I see any names.
